name: colSds
title: Standard deviation estimates for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Standard deviation estimates for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colSds(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE, refine = TRUE,
  center = NULL, dim. = dim(x), ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: refine
arguments.text: If TRUE, center is NULL, and x is numeric, extra effort is used to calculate the average with greater numerical precision.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional vector of length K. The center defaults to the column means. A length-1 value is an error.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: colSds calls colVars and returns the square root. sqrt of NA stays NA.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K.

translation.description: Standard deviation estimates for each column in a matrix.
translation.usage:
colSds(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, refine=True,
       center=None, dim=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A 1-d vector is accepted when dim is set; it is filled column-major.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, NaN values are excluded before the variance. This is na.rm.

arguments.name: refine
arguments.text: Passed to colVars. The residual pass runs when center is omitted and x is floating point.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional column means, passed to colVars. None estimates them internally.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the number of rows and columns. This is dim. in R.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. The result is a plain float64 vector.

translation.details: colSds calls colVars and takes the square root. When the variance is R's NA, bits 0x7ff00000000007a2, that payload is copied onto the result.
translation.value: A float64 vector of length equal to the number of selected columns.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowsds import colSds

x = np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F")
colSds(x)
